sizing_gate.reason: 13 target files and 4 nameable concerns (layout reorder, 2 relabels, Kit Users move, Pro-gate seam) exceed the >6-files / multiple-concerns threshold.
sizing_gate.recommendation: DO NOT SPLIT. The epic DEV-2409 has already split this work ten ways, and this ticket is the irreducible foundation all 9 siblings are blocked on. The four concerns are not separable: the reorder and the Kit Users removal are the SAME array edit, and the Pro-gate seam rewrites the same getStats() the reorder touches. Splitting would create sub-PRs conflicting on the same three files while leaving every sibling blocked longer. Recorded and proceeding.
sizing_gate.files_note: 9 of the 13 are the tightly-coupled Company Metrics grid surface; 5 are tests.

execution.why: The DAG's real dependencies (seam -> grid wiring -> seam test) serialize most of the work anyway, so fan-out would buy one parallel wave at the cost of 3 worktrees, 3 vendor copies and 3 DB provisions. More importantly, this epic's documented failure mode is SLICE BLINDNESS -- eight review rounds, each finding an unrepaired sibling of the previous fix. One worker holding the whole coherent change in a single context is the better defence against that than three workers each seeing a third of it.

subtasks.title: Company Metrics foundation: seam, reorder, relabels, Kit Users move
subtasks.approach: Execute in this order; each step's rationale is in prep-context.json (settled[]) and driver-verifications.md. TDD: write/adjust the pinning test first, confirm red, then green.
ordered_steps: STEP 1 -- shared label source. Move getCardLabel() from DashboardWidget.php:272 into the RendersDashboardStat trait and DELETE the DashboardWidget copy (DashboardWidget already `use`s the trait at line 17, so all 6 subclasses are unaffected). Guard it: `$heading = \method_exists($this, 'getHeading') ? $this->getHeading() : null;` -- KitUsers uses this trait but extends TableWidget and has NO getHeading(); unguarded this is a latent fatal. Behaviour is byte-identical for every current caller. See driver-verifications.md #7.

STEP 2 -- the seam. Add `public static function canViewCardData(): bool;` and `public function lockedStat(?string $selectedCard = null): Stat;` to the DashboardMetricCard interface. Supply defaults in RendersDashboardStat: canViewCardData() returns true; lockedStat() builds a Stat from getCardLabel() with NO computed value, NO ->chart(), and NO wire:click / x-bind / data-description in extraAttributes (use a distinct data-dashboard-locked attribute instead of the clickable chrome from dashboardStatAttributes()). canViewCardData() MUST be static -- expandableCards() filters class-strings without instantiating.
STEP 3 -- stale comment in this file. Fix DashboardWidget.php:299 ('so the eight cards stay color-coordinated').

STEP 4 -- relabels. RecoveryCounts.php: $heading -> 'Total Repossessions' AND getDatasetLabel() -> 'Total Repossessions' (operator-approved, Q3). RecoveryLeader.php: BOTH $heading at :25 AND the hardcoded Stat::make() literal at :234 -- it overrides toStat() and bypasses getCardLabel(), so changing only one leaves the collapsed card and the expanded chart title disagreeing.

STEP 5 -- Kit Users move. HotlistCount.php: getColumns() becomes RESPONSIVE (['default' => 1, 'sm' => 2, 'md' => 3, 'xl' => 6]) per operator answer Q1, not a flat int 6. Add a memoized `private ?KitUsers $kitUsers` composed via `new KitUsers` (never Livewire-mounted -- the same adapter pattern CompanyMetricsOverview already uses) and insert a Stat at INDEX 4 (between 'Missing Plates Percentage' and 'Staging'): Stat::make('Active Kit Users', number_format(activeKitUsersCount()))->description(number_format(cameraKitsCount()).' camera kits'). NOTE the description is CAMERA kits, NOT the 'inactive kits' KitUsers::toStat() currently shows -- that is a genuine value change settled by the mockup, easy to get backwards.

STEP 6 -- theme.css. Update the .big-stat-chart min-h-40 calibration comment so it describes the 6-column reality; its current text pins 160px to 'that row's height at the default 5-column width' and instructs the reader to revisit when the top row's copy changes. Do NOT change the 160px value blind -- flag it for visual re-check in human QA (operator answer Q1).

STEP 7 -- grid. CompanyMetricsOverview.php: cards() becomes exactly ['scan-count','recovery-counts','recovery-leader','live-hits','historical-hits','staging-live-hits','staging-historical-hits'] (kit-users dropped). Rewrite BOTH docblocks (:12 '8-card grid' and :34 'The 8 compact cards') to record the 4x4 mockup with the 9 empty slots named and marked load-bearing, explicitly forbidding a future re-tidy to append order. Add static expandableCards() = array_filter(cards(), fn ($c) => $c::canViewCardData()). In getStats(), branch on $class::canViewCardData() BEFORE calling toStat() -- gating after the value is computed is the data-leak defect this seam exists to prevent.

STEP 8 -- page wiring. Dashboard.php: cardWidgets() returns CompanyMetricsOverview::expandableCards() instead of cards(); rewrite the stale :84 docblock (wrong on count, labels, membership AND row structure). DO NOT add key validation to toggleCard() -- see driver-verifications.md #1: it needs none, and an `if (! isset(...)) return;` guard breaks closing a card that became locked while open.

STEP 9 -- tests. DashboardCardExpansionTest.php: assertCount(8)->7, update the exact key-order array, drop the stale 'RecoveryLeader/KitUsers do not implement getCardKey() yet' comment (both do). Leave test_all_four_hit_cards_are_contiguous() UNMODIFIED -- it is order-agnostic and must pass as-is. RecoveryLeaderTest.php:214: the assertSame() exact match becomes 'LPR Recovery Leaderboard'. HotlistCountTest.php: pre-seed the 'kit-status:active-ids:org=' and 'kit-status:total:org=' cache keys (mirroring the existing hotlist-count pre-seed pattern) so no live ClickHouse call is attempted, then assert the new stat and its camera-kits description. NEW tests/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/Concerns/DashboardCardVisibilityTest.php: with local stub cards on a CompanyMetricsOverview subclass, prove a canViewCardData()=false card (a) stays in cards(), (b) is ABSENT from expandableCards(), (c) renders with no value/chart/click affordance, and (d) has its value never computed -- assert the gated card's cache key is never written, which is the AC-4 'shows no value' proof.

STEP 10 -- AC-7. No new ClickHouse call site may be introduced. KitUsers' two queries already run today (it is currently a grid card), so relocating them is net-neutral; the regression guarded against is a re-implementation that does not reuse those two cache keys. Prove it by code-path audit + the HotlistCountTest cache-key assertions from step 9. DB::listen does NOT fire for the CH driver -- do not attempt a query-listener count.
